name: felinics/Memoh
title: felinics/Memoh
headline: Memoh gives each agent its own computer and memory
lede: You can run multiple agents that each get their own computer, desktop, network and long-term memory.

effects.effect: Per-agent machines make isolated multi-agent setups easier.

appearances.title: felinics/Memoh
appearances.summary: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory. You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.

appearances.title: felinics/Memoh
appearances.headline: Memoh gives each agent its own computer and memory
appearances.newly_possible: You can run multiple agents that each get their own computer, desktop, network and long-term memory.
appearances.why: It can host coding agents like Claude Code and Codex with your own key.
appearances.limits: No evidence of reliability or isolation is supplied.

ripples.effect: Per-agent machines make isolated multi-agent setups easier.
